articles.summary: In this series, we’ve explored bioelectronics and neuromodulation; how they’re changing the lives of patients, the major players in the industry, and how it’s regulated. We’ve also thrown in some thoughts from neuroscientists on how these new fields could benefit from looking at existing drug development processes for model translation and scaleup. This time, we’ll be looking at the future of precision medicine and the role that artificial intelligence and neural implant technology will play.AI
articles.title: BIOELECTRONICS PART 4: BIOELECTRONICS AND THE FUTURE OF PRECISION MEDICINE
